-- Declarations and implementations for first_readable.

-- True only for a single file name with no path parts,
-- so a name cannot step outside the confined directory.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  pre True
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  ex is_plain_name("") == False
  name.char_count() > 0 and name != "." and name != ".." and name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1

-- Text of notes/name, or "" when the name is not plain or the file
-- is missing or unreadable. Reads only through the fs capability,
-- which the caller has already narrowed to the notes directory.
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre is_plain_name(name)
  ex read_note("no-such-file-xyz") == ""
  fs.read(name) else ""

-- Text of the first name in names that reads from notes, or "" if none do.
-- The capability is narrowed to notes before any name is read.
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      if is_plain_name(name)
        let text = read_note(name)
        if text != ""
          return text
  ""

test_plain_names() =
  assert is_plain_name("a.txt")
  assert is_plain_name("../x") == False
  assert is_plain_name("sub/x") == False
  assert is_plain_name("..") == False
